This small plot is rented, so I cannot put too much of my money into it — if I improve the soil too much, the owner may take it back or raise what he asks from me next year. Here in Chikwawa the rains are not reliable and it gets very hot, so I must be careful. I will put a little manure from my goats because that costs me nothing, and I will use the seed I saved from last season since I do not get a FISP coupon for this crop. I will weed with my family, and maybe hire one or two people when the weeding is heavy, because the plot is small but the sun is strong and I have my other 0.8 hectares to look after too.
